remaining_scientific_limitations: The empirical progenitor-age law and survey cosmology correction are not established by mock-age injection.
Unrestricted gamma reaches its bound and lacks retained two-sided mass support despite formally full rank; inference withheld.
High-mass gauge is a selected-stratum width/colour refit, not survey-wide host-step calibration.
Percentile distributions condition on sparse native support; high-minus-low joint contrast uses51/200 fixed and39/200 gauge replicates; no established coverage.
The redshift high-minus-low contrast and high-mass gauge are declared exploratory extensions.
Training/evaluation attempt resampling omits cadence/host clustering, model/classifier retraining and survey systematics.
Literal and retained-age training differ in mean target and gamma/MUCOV centering; this is not a pure mean-map or official-pipeline reproduction.
The lower-limit repaired scatter cell and persistent zero-MAD failures remain evidence of sparse-cell instability.

exploratory_redshift_summary.scope: Post-pattern contrast, conditional supported-replicate distributions; no cosmological correction or verified interval coverage.

scaled_survey.scope: Hypothetical paired mock intervention and conditional native maps. Unsupported slopes/bins remain null; native covariance is not training-uncertainty or full-survey coverage.
